# AI podcast video generator for Claude Code: two consistent hosts

**Two character references and a short script become a studio dialogue video, each line spoken with native audio.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_cbdbf41b2929.webp" alt="Two AI podcast hosts at the same wooden table and brick wall: a woman in a teal T-shirt asks a question into a boom mic while a coach in a camouflage T-shirt answers in the matching close-up." width="480"></p>

Makes podcast-style and two-character dialogue videos on varg with AI characters who stay the same in every angle: an empty studio set, one wide master shot built from character references, close-ups and lighting cutaways derived from that master, then 5-second image-to-video scenes in which each character speaks their line with native audio, reviewed on an HTML storyboard and stitched into one MP4. Use when someone asks for a podcast video, an AI podcast, a video podcast with two hosts, an interview, debate or talk-show clip between two characters, a myth-vs-truth or "lie vs truth" explainer, or a short of talking characters trading punchy lines. Not for cutting an existing podcast recording into shorts (find a clipping skill with video-skills), one speaker on a stage (use varg-character-keynote), multi-location ads with real actors (use varg-consistent-characters), or songs (use varg-music-video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-podcast-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-podcast-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Stitched dialogue MP4 and HTML storyboard |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$8 per 9-scene video at 720p (estimate) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make an AI podcast clip with two hosts debating whether multitasking works, 9 scenes of 5 s each"
- "Create a myth-vs-truth video with a host and a trickster in a studio, using ./host.jpg and ./trickster.jpg"
- "Turn this 6-line dialogue into a talk-show video where both characters look the same from every angle"
